card.name: The ending -ette in pipette
card.fires_on: The final piece "ette" right after "pip" in the word pipette, in eye-drop instructions. It also fires on "ette" ending a name like Jeanette.

modes.label: Ending of a first name
modes.description: The ending "ette" completes a woman's first name in a web text list of authors.
modes.example: Pat Califia, Jean<<ette>> Winterson and Sarah Waters
